title: Vienna Delegate Expense Playbook (scratch)
content:
Purpose: quick personal playbook for the Vienna delegation — logistics, vendor contacts, expense reminders, VAT recollection notes, and a packing/booth checklist. This is a working doc (notes to self + items to hand to finance/events).

Attendees (confirmed):
- Aisha Patel (lead) — exp lead + booth ops
- Marco Diaz — AV lead / on-site vendor coordination
- Sofia Chen — sales/demo lead
- Possible: Jun Park (TBD) — check travel cap

High-level dates: 2026-04-12 (arrive) to 2026-04-16 (depart). Conference days: 2026-04-13—14. Booth teardown 15 morning. Buffer day 16 for travel.

Flights (booked / to verify):
- Aisha: LAX -> VIE on OS 69, dep 2026-04-12 10:30 PDT, arr 2026-04-13 07:45 CEST (note long layover in FRA) — upload boarding pass to Expensify
- Marco: SFO -> VIE (via MUC) — check luggage allowance for tech crate (2x 32kg allowed?)
- Sofia: booked via company card, keep original receipts/email confirmations

Hotel: Hotel Sans Souci (group block) — check in 4/12, check out 4/16. Reserve under Redwood Inference / Events Ops. Confirm VAT invoice at checkout (company name + VAT ID).

Local transport:
- Airport transfer: recommended - book via hotel shuttle or Bolt (receipt required).
- Public: buy 48h/72h ticket if attending city events. Keep screenshots/receipts for expense.

Booth / vendor notes (AV + furniture):
- AV vendor: ViennaTechEvents GmbH — contact: Thomas Kruger, +43 1 234 5678, thomas.kruger@vtevents.at 
  - Order: Dual 4K monitor stand, HDMI extenders, 3m audio line, 2x power strips, 1x ethernet switch (5 port).
  - Setup window: 4/12 14:00—20:00. Confirm crew arrival ETA 13:30.
- Crate shipping: ship to venue receiving (address on Confluence). Label crate with "Redwood — Booth 42" and contact phone (Marco). Keep AWB/receipt for customs if needed.
- Internet: request dedicated wired line or verified wifi SSID for demo machines (need static IP? ask infra).

Expense & reimbursement rules (notes to finance and delegation):
- Use company card where possible for vendor invoices. For personal outlays: Expensify preferred, receipts required for any item >€10.
- Meal per diem: follow Redwood policy (see Confluence page). If exceeding per diem, include business justification.
- Taxi/Bolt/Uber receipts: must include date, route, and amount. No cash without receipt (photograph and attach).
- VAT: Austria VAT is recoverable for business expenses. Must collect original VAT invoice (not just receipt) that includes: company name (Redwood Inference Inc.), company VAT ID (will paste below), vendor VAT number, invoice total, VAT amount. If vendor only issues credit card slip, ask for a proper invoice.
- VAT reclaim process: finance will file EU VAT reclaim. Deadline: submit receipts to finance within 30 days of return. Flag any hotel invoices that list personal spending (mini-bar) — separate those.

Company VAT info to provide to vendors:
- Redwood Inference Inc.
- Address: 1120 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
- VAT / Tax ID: US-EIN: 12-3456789 (confirm with finance for EU reclaim) — REMINDER: cross-check with finance before sharing.

Receipts checklist (for each attendee):
- Flight confirmation (email / e-ticket)
- Hotel folio / VAT invoice (must include VAT breakdown)
- AV vendor invoice + pro-forma + proof of payment
- Shipping AWB + customs clearance docs (if any)
- Meals (itemized if >€25)
- Local transport receipts (taxi, rental, parking)
- Misc: printing, signage, booth incidentals — include vendor name/date/purpose

GL codes (quick reference) — share with finance on submission:
- Travel flights: EVT-TRVL-501
- Hotels: EVT-HOT-502
- Booth/AV: EVT-BOOTH-510
- Shipping: EVT-SHIP-515
- Meals/entertainment: EVT-LIV-520
(note: check actual GLs with finance; these are placeholders for personal tracking)

Booth setup checklist (Aisha / Marco owner):
- [ ] Confirm crate arrival window and on-site contact (Venue receiving desk + Thomas)
- [ ] Verify AV cable list vs. demo machine outputs (USB-C -> HDMI adaptors x3)
- [ ] Test internet connectivity & get admin creds for booth SSID
- [ ] Power strips labeled and surge-protected
- [ ] Print banner + business cards + QR-code cards with tracking URL (order from PrintCo—use PO)
- [ ] Bring travel toolkit: multi-plug adapter (EU), gaffer tape, cable ties, small toolkit
- [ ] Assign teardown roles and confirm courier for return crate (FedEx preferred)

Vendor payment notes: collect invoice + proof of service. For any vendor needing immediate payment on-site, get an itemized invoice and prefer company card. Marco to log any cash payments and uploader receipts immediately.

On-site daily stand-up (recommended): 08:15 — 08:30 at booth each conference day. Quick topics: demos schedule, laptop battery swaps, demo leads, escalation path.

Post-conference debrief & finance handoff (deadline + owners):
- Within 7 days of return: compile all receipts into one folder and upload to Finance Confluence page (linked).
- Use expense template (attached to Confluence) and tag GL codes per line item.
- Marco to submit AV/shipping invoices direct to finance (EVT-AV-#).
- Aisha to collect hotel VAT invoice and verify company name on invoice.

Sample expense memo (paste into Expensify notes):
"Vienna AI Week — Redwood booth travel and AV. Dates 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-16. Attendees: Aisha Patel, Marco Diaz, Sofia Chen. Purpose: product demos, partner meetings, booth presence. Items: flights, hotel, AV rental, shipping, meals. VAT invoices attached where applicable. GL codes included in attached spreadsheet."

Questions / open items (TO RESOLVE):
- Confirm whether Jun Park travel is pre-approved under headcount cap. (Action: ping People ops)
- Confirm exact VAT ID string with finance (needed for invoices).
- Do we need EU PSN or customs broker for crate if >€1000 value? Check with shipping.
- Who is responsible for printing QR tracking cards? (Action: assign to Sofia)

Quick packing checklist (for each person):
- Passport + paper boarding passes (if issued)
- USB-C power bank (airline-compliant)
- EU plug adapter + multi-plug
- Laptop + charger + 2x HDMI adaptors + display dongle
- Demo keys / credentials (store in password manager + offline note)
- Printed schedule + meeting list (one pager)

Emergency contacts:
- Embassy (US consulate Vienna) — +43 1 1234 000 (confirm exact number before travel)
- Hotel front desk: Hotel Sans Souci, +43 1 798760
- On-site venue operations: +43 1 9876 5432 (venue ops)

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep receipts scanned as soon as you get them — use Expensify mobile app for on-the-spot uploads.
- If vendor resists issuing VAT invoice, escalate to Thomas (AV vendor) and request company billing contact for formal invoice.
- Double-check all demo machines for language/keyboard settings and power plug compatibility.
- Remind team to toggle phones to roaming or local SIM (we use Bolt more often) — budget for eSIM if needed.

References & quick links:
- Confluence: Vienna-2026 (logistics) — https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVENTS/Vienna-2026
- Event Jira epic: EVT-721 — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/EVT-721
- Expense template: (link in Confluence)

End of scratchpad — will hand off cleaned checklist + expense spreadsheet to finance after trip.
